verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an authenticator with cloud sync, so the axis applies. But the evidence shows sync runs only through the user's Google Account, with no documented self-hostable backend. Offline use without an account, open-source OTP generator implementations and the PAM module are adjacent building blocks or local use, not a self-hosted deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
